general: Wear a laboratory coat, safety goggles and closed shoes at all times.
Never taste or smell chemicals directly; use your hand to waft fumes towards you.
Keep the workbench clean and free of bags, water bottles and loose papers.
Know the location of the first-aid box, fire extinguisher and emergency exit.
Switch off ovens and balances when the practical is finished.
Wash your hands thoroughly with soap after handling paint and solvents.
experiment: Handle the porcelain dish / crucible carefully; it is brittle and gets very hot.
Always cool the porcelain dish in the desiccator before weighing it.
Never open the oven with bare hands while a dish is inside.
Set the oven accurately to 120 C for this experiment.
Do not exceed a 1 g paint sample; a thick layer dries unevenly.
Record every weighing only after the balance shows a stable reading.
Keep solvents away from any open flame; paint thinner is flammable.
